name: Tadle
description: Tadle is a next-generation pre-market infrastructure designed to enhance liquidity and engagement for pre-market assets in the crypto space. It features three core marketplaces that allow users to trade pre-TGE points, complete missions for rewards, and predict key outcomes in a decentralized environment. Tadle aims to unlock liquidity and maximize engagement by providing dynamic collateral options, ensuring that traders can minimize capital risk while optimizing their trading strategies. With advanced trading tools and robust security measures, Tadle fosters trust and confidence among users, addressing common issues faced by existing platforms in the crypto pre-markets.
